sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was raised materially: 2026 revenue raised $2B at both ends to $82B-$85B and EPS raised $2.00 at both ends to $35.50-$37.00, representing 28% growth midpoint. The revenue beat of $19.8B against ~$17.6B expected and EPS more than doubling year-over-year further support a strong positive shift in forward expectations. No meaningful risks or hedges offset this raise.
